diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-1 Air cleaner filter
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the front-mounted air cleaner housing showing the cover, three securing wing nuts, viscous paper filter element, and engine bay perspective.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Viscous paper element requires no cleaning; never clean with brush or compressed air blast.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-2 Air cleaner and air duct
diagrams.description: Exploded assembly and Section A-A cross-section of the air cleaner ductwork, clamps, and mounting to the radiator core support reinforce.
measurements_and_specs: Four mounting screws (two upper, two lower)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Air duct connects between air flow meter and air cleaner horn with hose clamps.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-3 Electronic fuel injection air and fuel flow system
diagrams.description: System flow diagram showing fuel delivery from fuel tank through pump, damper, filter, rail, pressure regulator, and injectors, alongside air passage through air cleaner, air flow meter, throttle chamber, cold start valve, and auxiliary air regulator.
measurements_and_specs: Fuel line pressure maintained at 2.55 kg/cm² (36.3 psi) higher than intake manifold vacuum
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Surplus fuel returns to the tank via the pressure regulator; air regulator provides bypass air during warmup.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-4 Electronic control signal
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic outlining power distribution from battery and ignition switch through main and fuel pump relays, sensor signal inputs to the control unit, dropping resistor connections, and injector drive circuits.
measurements_and_specs: Injectors 1 to 6 fed via two 3-channel dropping resistors
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Power is routed via main relay and fuel pump relays; output pulses drive injectors in parallel groups through dropping resistors.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-5 Control unit block diagram
diagrams.description: Functional block diagram of control unit electronics showing internal stages IC1 (wave shaping, frequency conversion), IC2 (base pulse Tp calculation), IC3 (enrichment corrections Tq and voltage correction Ts), logic summation, and output power amplifier driving the 6 injectors.

callouts.4: Multi-vibrator base signal monitoring engine rpm and amount of intake air
callouts.7: Logic circuit base pulse + correction pulse + voltage correction pulse

wiring_and_connections: Input signals A-G fed into IC1, IC2, IC3
Output from power amplifier to parallel injectors
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Summation pulse Tg includes mechanical lag Ts; effective pulse Te delivers precise fuel quantity per rotation.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-6 Correction by cooling water temperature
diagrams.description: Characteristic graph plotting pulse width index against engine coolant temperature from -20°C (-4°F) to 80°C (176°F), showing enrichment falling to 1.0 at 70°C (158°F).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Coolant enrichment terminates once water temperature reaches 70°C (158°F).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-7 Correction by intake air temperature
diagrams.description: Characteristic graph plotting pulse width index against intake air temperature from -20°C (-4°F) to 40°C (104°F), showing enrichment falling to 1.0 at 20°C (68°F).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Intake air temperature compensation is active below 20°C (68°F).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-8 Correction of fuel enrichment
diagrams.description: Composite fuel flow versus time chart illustrating the overlapping fuel enrichment phases during cold cranking, warmup, idle, off-idle acceleration, and full throttle operation.
measurements_and_specs: Full throttle enrichment active at > 34° opening (~27% increase)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Shows sequential transition from Start switch ON to Start switch OFF, Idle switch ON/OFF, duration of after-start, duration of after-idle, and running mode.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-9 Fuel cut
diagrams.description: Chart illustrating deceleration fuel cut operating range: injection stops at 3,200 rpm when throttle idle switch is closed, and recovers at 2,800 rpm.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Requires idle contacts closed; prevents unnecessary fuel consumption and emissions during high-rpm deceleration.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-10 Altitude compensation
diagrams.description: Step graph of altitude enrichment ratio versus atmospheric pressure from 450 to 750 mmHg (16 to 30 inHg), stepping from 1.00 down to 0.94 below 660 mmHg (26 inHg).
measurements_and_specs: Switch point: 660 mmHg (26 inHg) / 1,120 m (3,675 ft)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: California models only; adjusts mixture lean to compensate for thinner air at high altitude.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-11 Control unit
diagrams.description: Isometric external view of the metal control unit box and its dash-mounting bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mounted on a bracket on the driver seat side dash panel.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-12 Air flow meter
diagrams.description: Cutaway perspective view of the mechanical air flow meter detailing the measuring flap, helical return spring, damping vane and chamber, idle bypass passage with adjust screw, potentiometer wiper, and internal electrical connector.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Damper chamber dampens flap flutter caused by cylinder intake pulses; bypass screw sets idle mixture.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-13 Air flow meter potentiometer
diagrams.description: Internal resistor schematic of the AFM potentiometer depicting the ladder network of tapped resistors R0 through R10 between terminals 6 and 9 with wiper pickoff 7.
components: Resistor ladder network (R0, R1 to R9, R10)
measurements_and_specs: Voltage ratio U/UB proportional to flap rotation angle
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Flap rotation slides terminal 7 across tapped resistor track; voltage signal U changes relative to reference UB.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-14 Air temperature sensor
diagrams.description: Illustration of the air flow meter intake mouth showing the physical location of the integrated thermistor air temperature sensor.
measurements_and_specs: NTC thermistor (resistance drops with rising temperature)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Sensing element is positioned directly in incoming air stream.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-15 Water temperature sensor
diagrams.description: Location view of the water temperature sensor threaded into the front thermostat housing.
wiring_and_connections: Connector terminal connects to ECU pin 13
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Monitors engine coolant temperature to determine enrichment duration.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-16 Thermotime switch
diagrams.description: Component location of the thermotime switch situated beside the water temperature sensor in the thermostat housing.
wiring_and_connections: Electrical harness connected to cold start valve
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Grounds cold start valve circuit during cold cranking.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-17 Operating principle of thermotime switch
diagrams.description: Functional circuit schematic of the thermotime switch bimetal element, electric heater winding, contact points, and plunger control to the cold start valve.
wiring_and_connections: Connected to starter circuit and cold start valve solenoid
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Internal heater heats bimetal to open contacts after several seconds of cranking to prevent engine flooding.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-18 Sectional view of cold start valve
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional drawing and Section A-A nozzle face view of electromagnetic cold start valve showing magnet coil, sheet valve, swirl chamber nozzle, and 60° spray pattern.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Swirl nozzle creates 60-degree cone for optimal low-temperature fuel atomization.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-19 Electronic fuel injection main relay
diagrams.description: Component location of the EFI main relay mounted on the engine compartment relay bracket.
wiring_and_connections: EFI harness plug connects to relay base
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Supplies system power when ignition switch is turned ON.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-20 Throttle valve switch
diagrams.description: External view and internal contact mechanism of the throttle valve switch showing idle contact points and full-throttle contact points.
measurements_and_specs: Full throttle contacts close at > 34° throttle opening
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Idle contacts close at closed throttle; full throttle contacts close beyond 34 degrees of throttle opening.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-21 Dropping resistor
diagrams.description: Location view of the dropping resistor pack near the windshield washer reservoir behind the left-hand inspection lid.
wiring_and_connections: Harness connector to injectors and ECU
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Accessible by opening LH inspection lid; limits current through injector solenoid coils.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-22 Altitude switch
diagrams.description: Mounting position and detail cutaway of the aneroid bellows altitude switch located behind the left instrument panel.
measurements_and_specs: Operating threshold: 660 mmHg (26 inHg) / 1,120 m (3,675 ft)
wiring_and_connections: Two-wire plug to control unit pins 9 and 12
diagrams.mechanic_notes: California models only; expands at high altitude to trigger microswitch.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-23 Fuel pump control relay and fuel pump relay
diagrams.description: Component location of the fuel pump control relay and fuel pump relay on the engine bay relay bracket.
wiring_and_connections: Interconnected with ignition switch, alternator L-terminal, and oil pressure switch
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Safety circuit shuts off fuel pump if engine stalls while ignition switch remains ON.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-24 Sectional view of fuel pump
diagrams.description: Longitudinal cutaway cross-section of the submerged wet-motor roller-vane electric fuel pump detailing internal rotor rollers, relief bypass valve, and check valve.
measurements_and_specs: Relief valve opening pressure: 3 to 4.5 kg/cm² (43 to 64 psi)
wiring_and_connections: Dashed line arrow: Relief valve actuated due to clogged discharge line
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Wet type design immerses motor in fuel; internal check valve retains line pressure after shutdown.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-25 Sectional view of fuel damper
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional drawing of the fuel damper housing, diaphragm, spring, and fuel flow chamber.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Damps hydraulic pulsations from the fuel pump; sealed unit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-26 Sectional view of pressure regulator
diagrams.description: Sectional view of diaphragm pressure regulator showing vacuum reference chamber, fuel chamber, valve seat, and return tube.
measurements_and_specs: Differential pressure maintained at 2.55 kg/cm² (36.3 psi)
wiring_and_connections: Vacuum hose connects to intake manifold
Fuel line returns to fuel tank
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Maintains constant 2.55 kg/cm² differential between fuel line pressure and manifold vacuum.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-27 Fuel filter
diagrams.description: Location view of the fuel filter canister on the right-hand side of the engine compartment.
measurements_and_specs: Replace filter body as an assembly
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Replace paper element and body as a unit per maintenance schedule.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-28 Injector
diagrams.description: Mounting detail of an injector in the intake manifold runner branch showing securing plate and fuel hose connection.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Directs spray pattern toward the intake valve head.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-29 Sectional view of injector
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional cutaway drawing of electromagnetic fuel injector detailing internal strainer filter, solenoid coil, core plunger, return spring, and needle valve seat.
measurements_and_specs: Fuel quantity proportional to open-valve pulse duration
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Solenoid coil lifts needle valve off seat against return spring force.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-30 Sectional view of air regulator
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional cutaway drawing of the auxiliary air regulator showing the bimetal strip, heating element, rotary shutter disc, sleeve, and air flow passages.
measurements_and_specs: Closes auxiliary bypass within a few minutes; remains closed until temp drops below 80°C (176°F)
wiring_and_connections: Terminal connected to fuel pump relay power circuit
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bimetal is electrically heated while engine runs, rotating shutter plate to shut off fast-idle bypass air.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-31 Air regulator characteristic curve
diagrams.description: Characteristic performance curves of auxiliary air regulator displaying rotary shutter opening area at 20°C (68°F), air flow in CFM versus warmup time in minutes, and air flow versus initial ambient temperature.
measurements_and_specs: Air flow at start: ~17.7 CFM at -20°C (-4°F), ~14.7 CFM at 20°C (68°F)
Warmup decay: drops to ~1.5 CFM within 6 minutes
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bimetal movement smoothly chokes off auxiliary air as heater warms element over 5-6 minutes.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-32 Throttle chamber
diagrams.description: Perspective illustration of the throttle chamber assembly mounted to intake manifold, depicting throttle shaft linkage, idle bypass screw, and TPS mounting.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Main throttle valve stays closed during idling; idle speed adjusting screw meters air through bypass passage.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-33 Electronic fuel injection harness
diagrams.description: Chassis perspective cutaway showing the comprehensive layout and routing of the EFI wiring harness from the driver's side cabin ECU through the firewall to engine bay sensors, injectors, and relays.
measurements_and_specs: 35-pin ECU connector under driver side dash
wiring_and_connections: Runs along driver side dash through firewall grommet into engine bay
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure harness grommet at firewall is sealed to prevent moisture ingress.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-35 Check at 35-pin connector ("R" range)
diagrams.description: Terminal pin layout diagram of the 35-pin ECU female harness connector illustrating pin positions 1 through 35 and test probe insertion for resistance checks.
measurements_and_specs: Circuit tester set to OHM 'R' range
wiring_and_connections: Pin arrangement: 1-18 right row, 19-35 left row
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not touch test probes to unnecessary connector pins to prevent socket damage.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-36 Checking for continuity with an ohmmeter
diagrams.description: Complete schematic diagram for harness continuity testing, displaying pin-to-component connections for all 35 ECU connector terminals, dropping resistors, fuel pump relays, ignition relay, injectors, air regulator, and sensors.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Refer to this schematic to isolate open or short circuits whenever continuity test between terminals A and B results in N.G.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-37 Check at 35-pin connector ("V" range)
diagrams.description: Procedure for checking voltages at individual terminals of the disconnected 35-pin ECU harness connector using a DC voltmeter connected to body ground under the dash near the pedals.
measurements_and_specs: Circuit tester set to DC VOLT (DC "V") range
wiring_and_connections: Positive voltmeter probe to terminal A
Negative voltmeter probe to body metal with lead wire
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn ignition switch to 'ON'. If test results check out 'N.G.', turn off ignition switch and disconnect battery ground cable before tracing circuit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-38 Checking for continuity with a voltmeter (1)
diagrams.description: Full electrical schematic showing power distribution and sensor/actuator circuits to the 35-pin connector for Continuity Check (1) using a voltmeter with ignition switch ON.
measurements_and_specs: Battery voltage check at 35-pin connector terminals: 1, 10, 15, 33, 32, 14, 30, 31
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use to trace open circuits when voltage is absent at check terminals in test 2-(1) through 2-(3).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-39 Thermotime switch harness connector short circuit
diagrams.description: Short circuiting the two terminals of the thermotime switch harness connector using a jumper wire to test the cold start valve circuit at pin 21 of the ECU connector.

callouts.Thermotime switch harness connector: Harness connector disconnected with jumper wire shorting both female terminals

wiring_and_connections: Short-circuit two pins of thermotime switch harness connector
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect thermotime switch connector and short circuit the two pins before checking terminal 21 at the 35-pin connector.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-40 Checking for continuity with a voltmeter (2)
diagrams.description: Full electrical schematic highlighting the starting circuits (terminal 4 starter signal, terminal 34 air regulator, terminal 21 cold start valve/thermotime switch) checked during Continuity Check (2) with ignition in START position.

callouts.4: Starter signal from ignition switch 'S' terminal
callouts.21: Cold start valve and thermotime switch circuit
callouts.34: Air regulator circuit from fuel pump relay

measurements_and_specs: Power line voltage present at terminals 4, 34, and 21 during cranking
wiring_and_connections: Terminal S of ignition switch to terminal 4 and starter motor
Fuel pump relay contacts to air regulator and terminal 34
Cold start valve to thermotime switch and terminal 21
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Trace circuits according to diagram if voltmeter reading is 'N.G.' during continuity check (2).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-41 Electronic fuel injection system wiring diagram
diagrams.description: Complete master electrical wiring diagram for the 1978 Datsun 280Z Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI) system, including fuel pump safety interlocks via alternator L-terminal and oil pressure switch, control unit pinout, relays, sensors, dropping resistor, and injectors.

callouts.Oil pressure switch: Engine oil pressure switch for fuel pump safety

measurements_and_specs: Switch state: Alternator 'L' terminal ON (stopped) / OFF (operation)
Switch state: Oil pressure switch OFF (stopped) / ON (operation)
wiring_and_connections: Battery to Fusible link to Main relay terminal 10 & 43
Ignition switch OFF/ON/START contacts B, IG, S
Alternator L terminal and oil pressure switch in parallel to Fuel pump control relay coil
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Primary reference wiring diagram for the complete EFI electrical sub-system on 1978 280Z.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-42 Checking control unit
diagrams.description: Connecting a 3V miniature test lamp to the fuel injector harness connector to check for injection pulse signals while cranking.
wiring_and_connections: Miniature lamp pins inserted into injector connector terminals
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Must check both No. 1 and No. 4 cylinders because separate power transistors drive cylinders 1-3 and 4-6.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-43 Miniature lamp for inspection
diagrams.description: Custom test tool consisting of a 3-volt miniature lamp soldered to lead wires with male spade terminals sized for injector connector pins.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use a 3V lamp with terminal pins matching the injector harness connector.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-44 Measuring the resistance between terminals ⑧ and ⑥
diagrams.description: Ohmmeter test measuring total track resistance across terminals 8 and 6 of the air flow meter connector.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Before checking air flow meter, remove battery ground cable.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-45 Measuring the resistance between terminals ⑨ and ⑧
diagrams.description: Ohmmeter test measuring resistance across terminals 9 and 8 of the air flow meter connector.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure resistance at connector terminals on removed AFM.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-46 Checking voltage variation between terminals ⑧ and ⑦
diagrams.description: Dynamic voltage test of the air flow meter flap potentiometer using a 12V DC power source connected to pins 9(+) and 6(-) while monitoring voltage variation on pins 8(+) and 7(-).
measurements_and_specs: Voltage across 8 and 7 decreases proportionately as flap opens
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Gradually open the flap by hand. If indication varies abruptly, the potentiometer is defective.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-47 Checking insulation resistance
diagrams.description: Checking insulation resistance between the metal body of the air flow meter and terminals 6, 7, 8, and 9.
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter leads between AFM body and terminals 6, 7, 8, 9
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If continuity exists between body and any terminal, air flow meter is faulty.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-48 Checking flap
diagrams.description: Hand check of the air flow meter vane flap to confirm smooth operation without binding throughout its range of motion.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Fully open the flap by hand. If binding occurs, replace the unit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-49 Measuring the resistance of air temperature sensor
diagrams.description: Measuring resistance between terminals 27 and 6 of the air flow meter connector to test the integral intake air temperature thermistor.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure ambient temperature and compare reading to specifications table.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-50 Checking insulation resistance
diagrams.description: Checking insulation resistance between terminal 27 of the intake air temperature sensor and the metal air flow meter body.
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter between terminal 27 and AFM casting body
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If continuity exists, the air temperature sensor and AFM assembly must be replaced.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-51 Measuring the resistance of water temperature sensor (on the engine)
diagrams.description: Measuring resistance of the cylinder head water temperature sensor on the vehicle using an ohmmeter connected to sensor terminals.
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter test probes on water temperature sensor terminals
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Measure before and after engine warm-up. Compare against radiator coolant temperature measured with rod thermometer.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-52 Measuring the resistance of water temperature sensor (off the engine)
diagrams.description: Bench testing the water temperature sensor immersed in a heated water beaker with a thermometer and ohmmeter.
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter attached to sensor pins while suspended in heated water
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Do not let sensor touch the bottom of the container. Stir water to maintain uniform temperature.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-53 Checking insulation resistance
diagrams.description: Insulation resistance check between the engine block and water temperature sensor terminals.
wiring_and_connections: One probe to engine block, second probe to sensor terminal
diagrams.mechanic_notes: If continuity exists between sensor terminal and engine block, sensor is grounded internally and faulty.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-54 Thermotime switch terminal number
diagrams.description: Terminal pin layout of the thermotime switch connector showing terminal 45 (G - Green) and terminal 46 (W - White).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: White terminal (46) is bimetal switch contact to ground; Green terminal (45) is internal heater coil.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-55 Checking thermotime switch
diagrams.description: Dynamic testing of the thermotime switch immersed in a heated water container with thermometer and ohmmeter observing switch opening above 25°C.
measurements_and_specs: Rate of temp increase: 1°C (1.8°F) per second
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Heat sensing portion must be dipped in water. Rate of temperature rise must be controlled to approximately 1°C/sec.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-56 Fuel injection from cold start valve
diagrams.description: Testing cold start valve fuel spray pattern and leakage by discharging into a graduated transparent glass container plugged with a clean rag.
measurements_and_specs: Container capacity: min. 20 cc (1.22 cu in)
wiring_and_connections: Jumper wire from battery to cold start valve terminals
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Cold start valve must not inject when ignition is in START with connector disconnected; must inject when energized via jumper wires.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-57 Electronic fuel injection main relay
diagrams.description: Terminal pin arrangement and internal schematic of the Electronic Fuel Injection Main Relay showing dual switch contacts and coil pins.
measurements_and_specs: Contact pairs: 10-71 and 43-72 closed when energized
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Connect an inline fuse in series with test lead wire before applying 12V to avoid damaging relay coil.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-58 Checking idle switch
diagrams.description: Connecting ohmmeter across terminals 2 and 18 of the throttle valve switch to verify continuity at idle and opening at ~4 degrees throttle angle.
measurements_and_specs: Valve open approx. 4°: No continuity (∞ Ω)
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter leads connected to pins 2 and 18
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Continuity should break when the throttle valve cracks open by approximately 4°.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-59 Checking full switch
diagrams.description: Connecting ohmmeter across terminals 3 and 18 of the throttle valve switch to verify full-throttle contact makes at approximately 34 degrees opening.
measurements_and_specs: Valve opened approx. 34°: Full contact made (continuity / low resistance)
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter leads connected to pins 3 and 18
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Gradually open throttle from closed to full. Ensure contact makes at approximately 34°.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-60 Checking throttle valve switch insulation
diagrams.description: Checking insulation resistance between the body of the throttle valve switch and terminals 2, 3, and 18 using an ohmmeter.
wiring_and_connections: One probe to throttle body / switch body metal, other probe to terminals 2, 3, and 18
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Reading should be infinite; any continuity indicates internal short to body ground.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-61 Dropping resistor terminal number
diagrams.description: Terminal pin layout of the dropping resistor 6-pin and 4-pin connectors showing individual cylinder resistor feed pins.
measurements_and_specs: Resistance per resistor segment: approximately 6 Ω
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect connectors before testing. Standard resistance is ~6 ohms for each of the 6 resistor sections.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-62 Checking altitude switch
diagrams.description: Checking altitude switch internal microswitch operation with ohmmeter while orally blowing into or sucking from discharge port.

callouts.Hold rubber area with hand to prevent ai: Grip rubber seal around port to prevent pressure leakage during oral test

measurements_and_specs: Click heard and switch continuity changes on ohmmeter scale
wiring_and_connections: Ohmmeter connected across altitude switch harness terminals
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hold rubber area with hand to prevent air leak. Switch is pre-set at factory and non-adjustable.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-63 Wiring diagram of fuel pump control system
diagrams.description: Wiring diagram of the fuel pump safety shutoff circuit including fuel pump relay, fuel pump control relay, ignition relay, oil pressure switch, and alternator L-terminal.

callouts.Alternator 'L' terminal: Grounds relay coil when alternator is not charging
callouts.Oil pressure switch: Closes contact when oil pressure rises to operate fuel pump relay

measurements_and_specs: Engine at rest: Alternator 'L' = ON, Oil pressure SW = OFF
Engine running: Alternator 'L' = OFF, Oil pressure SW = ON
wiring_and_connections: Alternator L terminal connected to Fuel pump control relay
Oil pressure switch wired to relay coil circuit
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Safety circuit prevents fuel pump operation if the engine stalls while ignition switch remains ON.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-64 Fuel pump control relay
diagrams.description: Terminal pinout and internal electrical circuit diagram of the fuel pump control relay showing terminals 91, 94, 95, 96, 97.
measurements_and_specs: Coil input: 12V DC across terminals 95 (+) and 94 (-)
wiring_and_connections: Terminal 96 grounded or ungrounded during test
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always install a fuse in series with 12V test voltage lead to prevent burning relay coils.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-65 Fuel pump relay
diagrams.description: Terminal pin layout and internal circuit schematic of the standard single-pole fuel pump relay showing coil terminals 90, 91 and contact terminals 92, 93.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Check continuity through terminals 90-91 and verify closure across 92-93 when energized.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-66 Releasing pressure in fuel system
diagrams.description: Depressurizing the fuel injection system prior to servicing by energizing the cold start valve with jumper wires connected to the battery for 2 to 3 seconds.

callouts.Cold start valve: Cold start valve on intake manifold

wiring_and_connections: Jumper leads from battery (+) and (-) to cold start valve connector pins
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CAUTION: Keep both terminals separate to avoid short circuit. Do not energize for more than 2-3 seconds.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-67 Connect fuel pressure gauge
diagrams.description: Connecting a fuel pressure gauge in-line between the fuel delivery pipe and the outlet hose of the fuel filter in the engine bay.

callouts.Fuel pressure gauge: 0-5 kg/cm² pressure gauge spliced into line

wiring_and_connections: In-line T-fitting between filter hose and metal fuel delivery pipe
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Starter 'S' terminal disconnected; ignition switch placed in START to activate fuel pump and read steady pressure.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-68 Injection operating sound
diagrams.description: Mechanic using a mechanic's screwdriver as a stethoscope placed against each fuel injector body to listen for operating click sounds.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: A low click or absence of clicking indicates a clogged or electrically open injector.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-69 Injector
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the fuel injector mounting hardware and seal assembly into the intake manifold.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always replace O-ring and inspect heat insulator during injector service.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-70 Valve opening at a temperature of 20°C (68°F)
diagrams.description: Internal rotary shutter valve opening profile inside the air regulator at 20°C (68°F) ambient temperature.

callouts.Direction of bimetal movement with incre: Arrow indicating shutter closing direction as heater warms bimetal

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Visually inspect aperture through port when cold; should match shaded crescent shape at 20°C.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-71 Air flow characteristic curve
diagrams.description: Dual performance graphs showing Air flow of air regulator (CFM) versus warm-up TIME (minutes), and Air flow versus starting Atmospheric temperature (°C/°F).
measurements_and_specs: Flow after ~6 min: drops to near 0 CFM
* Asterisk Mark (*) CFM: Cubic feet per minutes
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Illustrates auxiliary air bypass closing characteristic over elapsed time and starting temperature.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-72 Throttle chamber
diagrams.description: Manual checking procedures for throttle valve rotation and dashpot diaphragm rod travel on the throttle chamber assembly.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure throttle plate snaps closed smoothly and dashpot rod compresses without sticking.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-73 Dashpot adjustment
diagrams.description: Adjustment schematic for manual transmission dashpot showing clearance measurement between idle setscrew and throttle lever at 2,000 rpm.

callouts.1.9 mm (0.0748 in): Gap between idle setscrew and throttle lever at 2,000 rpm

measurements_and_specs: Engine speed: 2,000 rpm under no load
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen lock nut (indicated by arrow) and rotate dashpot body so rod tip contacts throttle lever at 1.9 mm clearance point.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-74 Checking air leakage in air intake system
diagrams.description: Comprehensive cutaway schematic of engine induction, crankcase ventilation, and vacuum plumbing identifying all 26 potential unmetered false-air leak inspection locations.

callouts.7: Injector mounting surface in intake manifold
callouts.8: Cylinder head mounting surface in intake manifold
callouts.9: Hose (air duct to air regulator pipe), both sides
callouts.10: Hose (throttle chamber to rocker cover), both sides
callouts.11: Hose (air regulator pipe to air regulator), both sides
callouts.12: Hose (air regulator to throttle chamber connector), both sides
callouts.14: Hose (pipe connector to P.C.V. valve), both sides
callouts.18: Automatic transmission vacuum line (Same vacuum hole)
callouts.25: Oil seal (on front and rear of crankshaft)

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Because AFM measures intake air directly, any false air leak at points 1-26 leans out the air-fuel mixture causing poor idle or stalling.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-75 Removing control unit cover
diagrams.description: Removing the plastic protective cover over the EFI control unit located on the driver side kick panel near the clutch/brake pedals.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn ignition OFF before removing cover or touching harness.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-76 Removing control unit
diagrams.description: Removing the three bracket bolts securing the metal EFI control unit casing to the left dash side panel.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note: 35-pin coupler can be disconnected without removing the control unit from the bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-77 Air flow meter
diagrams.description: Exploded view showing air flow meter removal from inner fender bracket, including rubber air ducts, clamps, bracket mounting bolts, and electrical connector.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Always disconnect battery ground cable first. Lift AFM upward to release harness connector underneath.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-78 Water temperature sensor
diagrams.description: Removing or installing the water temperature sensor on the front thermostat housing using an open-end wrench.
measurements_and_specs: Coolant drain: approx. 1.5 liters (1 5/8 US qt, 1 3/8 Imp qt)
wiring_and_connections: Keep sensor harness away from ignition high-tension plug wires
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Be sure to install copper washer. Keep wiring harness well clear of high tension spark plug leads.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-79 Thermotime switch
diagrams.description: Location of the thermotime switch threaded into the thermostat housing next to the water temperature sensor and thermal transmitter.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn counterclockwise to remove after draining cooling water.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-80 Fuel injection from cold start valve
diagrams.description: Depressurizing fuel lines before cold start valve removal by briefly energizing valve terminals with battery jumper leads.
wiring_and_connections: Battery positive and negative leads to valve terminals
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CAUTION: Keep terminals separated to prevent short circuits.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-81 Electronic fuel injection main relay
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the EFI main relay removal showing relay body, harness plug, mounting bracket, and securing screws.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect battery ground cable before unbolting bracket and disconnecting harness connector.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-82 Throttle valve switch
diagrams.description: Removing the throttle valve switch from the throttle chamber shaft after backing out two mounting screws.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Slowly pull switch straight forward off throttle valve shaft to avoid bending drive tangs.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-83 Adjusting throttle valve switch position
diagrams.description: Adjustment procedure for throttle valve switch: insert feeler gauge of clearance 'A' (1.3 mm / 0.051 in) between throttle lever and stop screw, rotate switch until continuity between terminals 2 and 18 breaks.
measurements_and_specs: Idle switch changes from ON to OFF at 1,400 rpm equivalent gap
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Adjust switch body position so idle circuit switches from ON (0 Ω) to OFF (∞ Ω) exactly as clearance A reaches 1.3 mm.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-84 Dropping resistor
diagrams.description: Location of the fuel injector dropping resistor pack mounted on the passenger/engine compartment bulkhead.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect battery ground cable and unplug both harness connectors before unbolting.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-85 Altitude switch
diagrams.description: Removal of the California altitude switch bracket under the driver's side instrument panel.

callouts.Remove two screws: Bracket mounting screws under driver side dash

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove lower dash cover on driver's side to access switch bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-86 Fuel pump control relay and fuel pump relay
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the dual fuel pump relay bracket under the dash showing fuel pump control relay, fuel pump relay, and main harness plugs.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect battery ground before removing relay bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-87 Releasing pressure in fuel system
diagrams.description: Releasing residual fuel line pressure using jumper wires from battery to cold start valve prior to fuel pump removal.
wiring_and_connections: Battery leads to cold start valve harness socket
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mandatory safety step before disconnecting any rear underbody fuel pump hoses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-88 Fuel hose clamp at fuel pump
diagrams.description: Applying a hose pinch-off clamp to the suction hose between the fuel tank and fuel pump under the rear body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Temporarily pinch off supply hose to prevent fuel tank from draining when disconnecting pump.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-89 Fuel pump removal
diagrams.description: Unbolting the fuel pump bracket mounting screws from the rear chassis underbody.
wiring_and_connections: Wiring harness through floor pan grommet
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect fuel pump harness connector inside passenger cabin under carpet/rear seat before pulling through floor grommet.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-90 Fuel damper removal
diagrams.description: Removing nuts securing the fuel pulsation damper to its chassis mounting bracket near the rear axle.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Keep drain pan under damper to catch residual fuel when disengaging hoses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-91 Pressure regulator removal
diagrams.description: Removing fuel pressure regulator screws from the intake manifold fuel delivery rail.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Place rag under regulator to absorb fuel spillage. Disconnect vacuum hose and unfasten fuel clamps.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-92 Fuel filter removal
diagrams.description: Removing the fuel filter from its engine bay mounting clamp bracket after loosening clamp bolt and disconnecting inlet/outlet hoses.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Catch fuel spillage with clean rag when disconnecting inlet and outlet rubber hoses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-93 Fuel pipe securing bolts
diagrams.description: Identification of mounting bolt locations securing the metal fuel delivery manifold gallery to the intake manifold.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove both the fuel pipe securing bolts and the two cold start valve bolts together.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-94 Removing fuel injector securing screws
diagrams.description: Using a screwdriver to remove the two screws securing each fuel injector holder bracket to the intake manifold.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove all screws on all 6 injector holders before attempting to pull fuel rail assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-95 Removing fuel pipe
diagrams.description: Lifting out the complete fuel rail assembly including delivery pipe, all 6 injectors, fuel pressure regulator, and cold start valve together.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pull assembly straight up to avoid twisting injector nozzles in manifold bosses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-96 Melting injector rubber hose
diagrams.description: Technique for slitting and removing high-pressure hose from injector tailpiece using a heated 150W soldering iron without damaging metal or plastic parts.

callouts.20 (0.79): 20 mm (0.79 in) cut length from socket

measurements_and_specs: Mark point: approx. 20 mm (0.79 in) from socket end
Soldering iron rating: 150 watt, heated for 15 minutes
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CAUTION: Do not let soldering iron touch metal tailpiece or melt plastic socket. Never place injector body in a vise.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-97 Injector
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the injector, O-ring, holder, and heat insulator mounting sequence.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Push rubber hose and socket onto tailpiece by hand as far as they will go; no clamp is used at the injector tailpiece connection.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-98 Air regulator removal
diagrams.description: Removal of the air regulator setscrews and auxiliary air hoses beneath the intake manifold.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Unfasten hose clamps on each side and back out the two setscrews.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-99 Throttle chamber
diagrams.description: Throttle chamber assembly installed on intake manifold with linkage and distributor cap area visible.
measurements_and_specs: Securing screw torque: 1.5 to 2.0 kg-m (11 to 14 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove distributor cap to gain clearance for throttle chamber removal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-100 Adjusting throttle valve switch position
diagrams.description: Setting throttle valve switch idle contact break point using feeler gauge between throttle lever and stop screw (gap A = 1.3 mm / 0.051 in) and ohmmeter on terminals 2 and 18.
measurements_and_specs: Engine speed equivalent: 1,400 rpm under no load
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Switch must open (ON to OFF) precisely at 1.3 mm throttle lever gap.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-101 Fuel hose clamp
diagrams.description: Detailed view of the special EFI rolled-edge screw-type fuel hose clamp.
measurements_and_specs: Tightening torque: 0.10 to 0.15 kg-m (0.7 to 1.1 ft-lb)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: CAUTION: Do not reuse fuel hose clamps after loosening. Replace with new clamps.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-102 Fuel hose clamp position
diagrams.description: Dimensional alignment showing clamp set 1 mm (0.04 in) back from the edge of the rubber fuel hose.

callouts.1 (0.04): 1 mm (0.04 in) margin from hose end

measurements_and_specs: Clamp position: 1 mm (0.04 in) from hose end
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure screw position does not rub against or contact adjacent chassis or engine components.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-103 Rubber hoses between pump and damper
diagrams.description: Assembly dimensions and insertion depths for fuel hoses 1 through 4 connecting fuel pump, connector pipe, and pulsation damper.
measurements_and_specs: Hose 1: 19 mm (0.75 in) clamp space, 1 mm margin
Pipe paint: This portion painted black
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hoses 1 and 4 must bottom against units; hoses 2 and 3 align with black paint marks on intermediate pipe.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-104 Fuel damper to fuel feed pipe rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion dimensions for hose connecting damper outlet to underbody fuel feed pipe.
measurements_and_specs: Insertion at pipe (6): 25 mm (0.98 in) to inner bulge
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Both ends bottom against unit flange or pipe bead bulge.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-105 Fuel feed pipe to fuel filter inlet pipe rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion dimensions for hose connecting underbody fuel feed pipe to fuel filter inlet pipe.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Push until hose ends contact inner bulge and filter casing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-106 Fuel filter outlet to fuel pipe rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion dimensions for hose connecting fuel filter outlet to engine bay fuel delivery rail.

callouts.10: 33 mm (1.30 in) from end of pipe

measurements_and_specs: Rail pipe insertion (10): 33 mm (1.30 in) from pipe end
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Note: Fuel pipe side must be pushed on exactly 33 mm from end of pipe.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-107 Cold start valve rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion depth specifications for the rubber hose feeding the cold start valve.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Valve side bottoms against casting; fuel rail side measures 33 mm.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-108 Injector rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion depth specifications for fuel injector rubber hoses to injector tailpiece and fuel delivery pipe spigots.

callouts.13: Hose socket contacts injector body (no clamp)
callouts.14: 33 mm (1.30 in) from end of fuel pipe

measurements_and_specs: Clamp offset: 1 mm (0.04 in) on fuel pipe side only
diagrams.mechanic_notes: No clamp is used on the injector tailpiece (13); clamp is only used on the fuel rail spigot (14).

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-109 Pressure regulator to fuel pipe rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion specifications for fuel pressure regulator inlet and outlet rubber hose connections to the fuel delivery rail and stay.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure hoses 16 and 18 are fully bottomed against their respective stops.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-110 Fuel pipe to fuel return pipe rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion specifications for hose connecting engine fuel rail return stub to underbody return line.

callouts.19: 33 mm (1.30 in) from end of fuel pipe
callouts.20: Contacts inner bulge on return pipe

measurements_and_specs: Return pipe insertion (20): 25 mm (0.98 in) to bulge
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Push onto return line until hose contacts inner bulge.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-111 Fuel return pipe to fuel tank rubber hose
diagrams.description: Insertion specifications for the rear hose connecting the chassis return tube to the fuel tank inlet nipple.

callouts.21: Contacts inner bulge on return pipe
callouts.22: 30 mm (1.18 in) from end of pipe

measurements_and_specs: Return pipe insertion (21): 25 mm (0.98 in) to bulge
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Be careful not to insert rubber hose into the bent portion of the tank connector pipe.

diagrams.caption: Fig. EF-112 Fuel rubber hoses
diagrams.description: Master vehicle layout diagram of the entire fuel feed and return system on the 280Z EFI showing all 22 high-pressure and low-pressure hose connection points, fuel pump, damper, filter, rail, injectors, cold start valve, pressure regulator, and fuel tank.

callouts.2: Pump to intermediate pipe hose (black paint)
callouts.3: Intermediate pipe to damper inlet hose (black paint)
callouts.6: Feed pipe inlet hose (contacts inner bulge)
callouts.7: Feed pipe outlet hose (contacts inner bulge)
callouts.8: Fuel filter inlet hose (contacts filter body)
callouts.9: Fuel filter outlet hose (contacts filter body)

callouts.11: Cold start valve feed hose at rail (33 mm)
callouts.12: Cold start valve inlet hose (contacts valve)
callouts.13: Injector hose to injector (socket contacts injector)
callouts.14: Injector hose to rail spigot (33 mm)
callouts.15: Regulator feed hose at rail (33 mm)
callouts.18: Rail return hose at stay (contacts stay)
callouts.19: Rail return hose to return line (33 mm)
callouts.20: Return line inlet hose (contacts inner bulge)
callouts.21: Return line outlet hose at tank (contacts inner bulge)

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine can not be started
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity open/short, fuel pump failure, control unit cranking circuit failure, injector inoperative, cold start valve inoperative (cold weather), main/fuel pump relay faulty, AFM flap stuck/potentiometer open, water temp sensor open/short, injector/cold start valve leakage, fuel pressure incorrect
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity at 35-pin connector 1-(3),(5),(6),(7),(8), 2-(1),(2),(3), 3-(1),(3); verify fuel pump sound; verify ECU cranking operation; check injector clicking sound; inspect cold start valve and thermotime switch; test relays; check AFM flap operation and resistance; check water temp sensor; inspect fuel system for leakage; test fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine stalls
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity open/short, fuel pump failure, control unit cranking circuit faulty, injector failure, air regulator faulty (warming up), relay faulty, AFM flap/resistance defect, water temp sensor defect, fuel leakage, fuel pressure defect
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(3),(5),(6),(7),(8), 2-(1),(2),(3); verify fuel pump sound and ECU cranking operation; check injector sound; check air regulator operation during warmup; test relays; check AFM flap and resistance; check water temp sensor resistance; inspect fuel leakage and fuel line pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Lack of power
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity fault, injector delivery fault, AFM flap/resistance error, throttle valve switch full contacts open, altitude switch fault, injector leakage, fuel pressure insufficient
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6),(9), 2-(1),(2),(3); check injector sound; inspect AFM flap movement and resistance; test throttle valve switch full load continuity; inspect altitude switch (California); check fuel leakage and fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine breathes
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity fault, control unit fault, AFM flap sticking/resistance faulty, altitude switch faulty, fuel pressure low
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6),(8),(9), 2-(1),(2),(3); test AFM flap operation and resistance; check altitude switch; verify control unit; check fuel line pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Unstable idling: During warming-up
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity defect, injector defect, air regulator closed/defective, water temp sensor out of spec, air temp sensor out of spec, throttle valve switch idle contacts open, fuel leakage, fuel pressure improper
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(3),(4),(5),(6),(8), 2-(1),(2),(3), 3-(2); check injector sound; inspect air regulator bypass operation; measure water temp sensor resistance; measure air temp sensor resistance; test throttle valve switch idle contacts; check injector/cold start valve leakage and fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Unstable idling: After warming-up
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity fault, injector delivery variation, water temp sensor faulty, throttle valve switch idle contacts open, altitude switch error, fuel leakage, fuel pressure improper
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(3),(4),(5),(6),(8),(9), 2-(1),(2),(3); check injector clicking; check water temp sensor resistance; check throttle valve switch idle contacts; check altitude switch; check injector/cold start valve leakage; test fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Higher idling speed
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity fault, air regulator remaining open, fuel leakage from injector or cold start valve
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(4),(5),(6), 3-(2); inspect air regulator shutter closure; check injector and cold start valve for internal leakage

troubleshooting.symptom: Running-on or dieseling
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Control unit malfunction, AFM flap sticking, sensor resistance error, throttle valve switch out of adjustment, fuel pressure high
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Inspect AFM flap operation and resistance; test water and air temp sensors; check throttle valve switch; test fuel pressure; replace control unit if necessary

troubleshooting.symptom: Back fire
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity defect, control unit error, AFM flap or resistance defect, water temp sensor defect, injector/cold start valve leakage, fuel pressure low
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(9), 2-(1),(2),(3); inspect AFM flap operation and resistance; check water temp sensor resistance; check fuel leakage and fuel pressure; replace control unit if needed

troubleshooting.symptom: After fire
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity defect, control unit error, AFM resistance defect, air temp sensor error, throttle valve switch idle/full error, altitude switch error, injector leakage, fuel pressure improper
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(3),(4),(5), 2-(3), 3-(1); check AFM resistance; check air temp sensor resistance; check throttle switch continuity; inspect altitude switch; check for leaky injectors; test fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Abnormal fuel consumption
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Harness continuity fault, cold start valve leaking/continuously operating, control unit error, AFM resistance defect, air temp sensor defect, throttle switch out of adjustment, external fuel leakage, injector/cold start valve leakage, fuel pressure too high
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check harness continuity 1-(1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(6), 2-(3), 3-(2); inspect cold start valve seating; test AFM resistance; check air temp sensor resistance; check throttle switch; inspect entire fuel system for external leaks; check injector leakage; measure fuel pressure

troubleshooting.symptom: Continuity check test results 'N.G.' at 35-pin connector terminals in DC 'V' range
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Open or short in wiring harness, relay, sensor, injector, or dropping resistor
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Turn off ignition switch, disconnect battery ground cable, and trace circuit in Figure EF-38 or EF-40

troubleshooting.symptom: Miniature test lamp does not flash when engine is cranked during control unit check
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Faulty control unit, low battery voltage (< 9V), or cranking speed below 80 rpm
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Verify battery voltage is > 9V and cranking speed > 80 rpm; if normal, replace control unit

troubleshooting.symptom: Miniature test lamp flashes when cranked, but does not become brighter when water temperature sensor connector is removed
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Faulty control unit or faulty water temperature sensor
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check water temperature sensor resistance; if sensor is normal, replace control unit

troubleshooting.symptom: Air flow meter potentiometer voltage indication varies abruptly as flap is opened
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Worn or defective potentiometer track in air flow meter
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace air flow meter assembly

troubleshooting.symptom: Air flow meter flap does not open smoothly or binds
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Mechanical obstruction or damaged flap pivot
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace air flow meter assembly

troubleshooting.symptom: Air temperature sensor resistance out of specification or shorted to body
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Defective thermistor inside air flow meter
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace air flow meter assembly (air temp sensor cannot be replaced separately)

troubleshooting.symptom: Water temperature sensor resistance out of specification or shorted to engine block
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Defective thermistor or internal ground short
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace water temperature sensor

troubleshooting.symptom: Thermotime switch resistance between terminal 45 and body not 51 to 62 ohms
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Open or burned heater coil in thermotime switch
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace thermotime switch

troubleshooting.symptom: Cold start valve injects fuel when unenergized, or fails to inject when 12V is applied
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Leaking valve needle or open solenoid coil in cold start valve
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace cold start valve

troubleshooting.symptom: Electronic fuel injection main relay fails continuity tests
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Burned coil or pitted/corroded internal contact points
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace electronic fuel injection main relay

troubleshooting.symptom: Altitude switch does not click or show continuity change when pressure/vacuum applied
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Defective internal microswitch or ruptured diaphragm
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace altitude switch assembly

troubleshooting.symptom: Fuel pump control relay or fuel pump relay fails continuity chart tests
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Defective relay coil or internal switch contacts
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace faulty relay

troubleshooting.symptom: Fuel discharge pressure not 2.55 kg/cm² (36.3 psi)
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Faulty pressure regulator, clogged fuel filter, restricted fuel lines, or worn fuel pump
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace pressure regulator and repeat test; if pressure is still low, check lines/filter, and if necessary replace fuel pump

troubleshooting.symptom: Fuel discharge pressure reading fluctuates excessively
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Defective diaphragm in fuel pulsation damper
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace fuel damper

troubleshooting.symptom: Low sound or no sound produced from particular fuel injector with engine idling or cranking
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Clogged injector, open injector coil, or faulty harness connection
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check injector coil resistance; if faulty, replace injector. If normal, inspect harness and control unit

troubleshooting.symptom: Sound heard from only cylinders 1-3 or only cylinders 4-6 injectors
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Blown injector driver power transistor inside EFI control unit
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace EFI control unit

troubleshooting.symptom: Engine speed does not reduce when air regulator hose is pinched during warm-up
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Air regulator rotary valve stuck open or open internal heater coil
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check continuity and mechanical movement; replace air regulator if faulty
